Schwarzschild.about: The Schwarzschild black hole is the simplest exact solution of Einstein's field equations. It has mass only and neither rotates nor carries electric charge.

Kerr.about: The Kerr solution describes a rotating black hole. Rotation drags spacetime around the black hole, producing an ergosphere.

Reissner-Nordström.about: A charged, non-rotating black hole described by the Einstein-Maxwell equations.

Kerr-Newman.about: The most general stationary black hole solution, possessing mass, angular momentum, and electric charge.
